The Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital, Sevagram Dist. Wardha (MS) invites applications for the following posts for appointments on temporary / Ad-hoc basis at Dr. Sushila Nayar Hospital, Utavali, Dharni (50 bedded Hospital in Tribal area of Dharni, Melghat) in the prescribed proforma (available on www.mgims.ac.in) along with the certified photocopies of academic and experience certificates should reach to the office of the Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital, Sevagram, Dist. Wardha (MS)- 442102, Maharashtra latest by 01/03/2025.
Click here to download the form

Qualifications -
The candidate must have completed a Diploma in General Nursing & Midwifery (GNM), B.Sc. Nursing, or Post B.Sc. Nursing with registration in Maharashtra Nursing Council, Mumbai
Experience -

Experience -

General Notes
The benefits of reservation shall be admissible to the backward class/ category candidates who are domiciled in the state of Maharashtra only.
Registration with Local Employment Exchange is mandatory.
Age limit, Educational Qualifications and experience shall be considered up-to last date of the application.
NOC certificate from the present employer is mandatory.
Age limit and or Experience can be relaxed by the appointing authority for otherwise qualified candidate.
Only eligible candidates will be called for Written / Skill test and shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification / Interview.
No of post may vary
Pay Scale is as per KHS rule
